label: Marketplace checklist registry for product-release-gate. A platform is 'pinned' only when an installed rig skill or a pinned policy text supplies its checklist. Every other platform blocks the marketplace stage; a checklist for one platform never satisfies another.

wordpress-plugin.source: Installed skill wordpress-org-compliance (hellokhoyer/wordpress-org-compliance, ref main, MIT, copyright 2026 Abul Khoyer), which audits against the WordPress.org Detailed Plugin Guidelines and Plugin Check
wordpress-plugin.note: Run the skill and record its result as marketplace_review

wordpress-theme.note: No installed theme-review skill; pin the Themes Team required list before use

woocommerce-extension.note: woocommerce-finalize is a code-health audit, not the Woo Marketplace submission policy; pin that policy before use

drupal-module.note: No installed Drupal.org project or security-coverage checklist

browser-extension-chrome.note: No installed Chrome Web Store policy checklist

browser-extension-firefox.note: No installed Mozilla add-on policy checklist

shopify-app.note: No installed Shopify App Store requirements checklist
